facts.fact: JICA says the Hanga Hub innovation hubs in Musanze and Huye ran an Ideation programme from 21 February to 11 March 2025 with 100 participants, 19 ideas moving to pre-incubation.
JICA says programmes ran at the innovation hubs in both Musanze and Huye, including business idea contests on 14 and 17 January 2025.
